newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cafe de Coral signs HK$200 mln revolver.
newsitem.headline: Cafe de Coral signs HK$200 mln revolver.

text.p: Cafe de Coral Holdings's revolving credit facility has been raised to HK$200 million from HK$150 million, arranger BNP Hong Kong said on Monday.
The facility has a tenor of three years and pays a margin of 87.5 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Proceeds of the facility will be used to finance the group's general working capital requirements.
Arrangers are ABN AMRO Bank, Bank of Tokyo Mitsubishi, Banque Nationale de Paris and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank.
Some four other banks have joined the deal. They are Banque Indosuez, Fuji Bank, Sanwa Bank and Sumitomo Bank.
